  SELECT sector, pct_above_50dma, stage2_pct
  FROM breadth.sector_daily
  JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ON breadth.sector_daily.snapshot_date = breadth.ma_pct_above.snapshot_date

ORDER BY stage2_pct DESC
